name: Wizard
body:
Alignment: Any

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s wizard class levels learns all wizard spells their mentor has currently prepared, adding them to their list of spells known for the day. The apprentice casts spells learned from a wizard mentor as arcane spells. Spells cast this way use the apprentice’s Charisma regardless of what ability their mentor uses to modify their spells. This ability does not allow an apprentice to cast spell they cannot learn due to their Charisma score or level. Apprentices treat spells learned this way just as any other spontaneous spell caster would their spells known. Your caster level is equal to your apprentice level, and your save DCs and concentration checks are Charisma-based. You’re considered to have the sorcerer/wizard spell list for purposes of spell completion items and spell trigger items.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s wizard class levels and chooses wizard for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains the wizard‘s arcane school class feature. The apprentice must select the same arcane school as his mentor. When determining which arcane school abilities the apprentice gains and those abilities effects, the apprentice’s effective wizard level is equal to his apprentice level minus 3. In addition, the apprentice gains a bonus metamagic feat, item creation feat, Spell Mastery feat, or arcane discovery his mentor possesses.

Cooperation Power

Key ability: Intelligence

Apprentices who study a mentor’s wizard class levels and chooses wizard for their cooperation power may spend a cooperation point as an immediate action when they or an ally casts a spell to increase the caster level of that spell by 1.
